camel_example: aliyun live SetLiveLazyPullStreamInfoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --PullProtocol rtmp --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PullDomainName 'guide.aliyundoc.com' --AppName ali_all_app
kebab_example: aliyun live set-live-lazy-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name ali_all_app --pull-domain-name guide.aliyundoc.com --pull-protocol rtmp --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLiveLazyPullStreamInfoConfig

parameters.help_en:
The name of the application.

To trigger origin fetch for all applications, set this parameter to ali_all_app
parameters.help_zh:
播流所属应用名称。

如果需要全部App都触发回源，则取值ali_all_app
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The origin server that hosts the live stream. To specify multiple origin servers, separate them with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所在的源站。多个源站使用英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: pull_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The source application name.

Leave this parameter empty to use the application name from the playback URL of the source stream
parameters.help_zh:
回源拉流App。

如果使用播放URL中的App，则此参数为空
parameters.name: pull_app_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger stream pulling when a request for a transcoded stream is made. Default value: no. Valid values:

yes

no
parameters.help_zh:
转码播放触发拉流。默认为no。可选值：

yes

no
parameters.name: transcode_lazy

parameters.help_en:
The protocol to use for pulling the stream from the source. Valid values:

rtmp

httpflv

hls
parameters.help_zh:
回源拉流协议。取值：
rtmp
httpflv
hls
parameters.name: pull_protocol
